reason: Verification passed but fidelity is low (RMSE ~0.31, 8-day T50 error) and key behavioral metrics (Rb, churn) are NaN. Critical evaluation-alignment and event-counting issues are identified with clear, feasible fixes that should materially improve both correctness and accuracy. We are at iteration 0 of 3, so there is room for impactful improvements.

specific_areas: Align evaluation strictly to the forecast window (days 30–39) using day-indexed observed series
Disable/gate early stopping until after prediction_end_day to avoid truncated forecasts
Compute observed Rb and churn from microdata (train_data.csv) and compare to simulated series (MAE)
Track adopted_today events and use them for new adopters to capture re-adoptions (stop relying on first_adoption_day for counts)
Export a separate predictions CSV for the forecast window (days 30–39) with adoption rate and Rb/churn slices
Add subgroup inequality diagnostics (difference and Gini) and report policy_effect_size
Calibrate layer influence weights (family > work/school > community) and complex contagion nonlinearity
Implement numerical safeguards to avoid NaNs (denominator checks, smoothing for sparse events)
Report additional diagnostics: per-day absolute errors, MAE, peak timing/height error
Ensure reproducibility (rng_seed) and fix preprocessing consistency across runs

task_understanding.adjustments: Reinforce that predictions are evaluated over days 30–39; model must reflect a two-stage process (information then behavior), complex contagion, stronger family-layer influence, and policy/messaging starting Day 10.

data_analysis.adjustments: From microdata, compute day-indexed observed adoption, Rb, and churn via per-agent transitions; prepare subgroup adoption by age/occupation for inequality and assortativity checks.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan explicit logistic hazard with quadratic term (complex contagion), policy odds multipliers, and churn dependent on local norms; set calibration targets for early Rb, adoption latency, and churn; prioritize layer weight tuning.

code_generation.adjustments: Implement event-based adopted_today tracking; store observed adoption as day->rate dict; gate early-stop until after prediction_end_day; compute and return Rb/churn series; export predictions for days 30–39; add Gini and policy_effect_size outputs.

code_verification.adjustments: Add tests to verify evaluation window alignment, non-NaN Rb/Churn when data available, and that early-stop cannot trigger before prediction_end_day; validate reproducibility via fixed rng_seed.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Run full horizon through day 39; log adopted_today/new_adopters and dropouts per day; perform a small sensitivity sweep on layer weights and mandate strength to check stability.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Compute RMSE and MAE strictly on days 30–39, TimeTo50 error, Rb_MAE, Churn_MAE; provide per-day errors and peak timing error; include subgroup inequality (difference + Gini) and policy_effect_size.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Return the full adoption_rate_over_time for days 30–39, highlight where errors concentrate (early vs late), and provide targeted parameter adjustment recommendations based on Rb/churn discrepancies.
